dedupe_keys.name: machine learning assisted multi hazard earthquake tsunami fragility surface dataset

description: This DesignSafe project presents a machine-learning method for generating multi-hazard earthquake-tsunami fragility surfaces for buildings, with the resulting fragility data. It was published on DesignSafe in 2025 by Mojtaba Harati and John van de Lindt. The model synthesises three-dimensional fragility surfaces from randomly selected two-dimensional earthquake and tsunami fragility curves, with physics-informed integration for the interaction of the two hazards, lower computational cost than physics-based generation, and surfaces that can be adjusted to test retrofits. The authors present the fragility functions as benchmarks for performance-based seismic and tsunami engineering and suggest adapting the method to other sequential hazards such as hurricanes, floods and wildfires. Coverage: building archetypes from the source fragility curves; the metadata read names no region. Access: DesignSafe Data Depot. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: the archetypes and file formats were not listed in the part of the metadata read. Simulation uses: combined earthquake and tsunami damage in community resilience models. Related records: the RIESGOS state-dependent tsunami fragility data and INSSEPT.
